title: VelocityUtilsLink
body: # 🌐 VelocityUtils Backend Plugin This plugin acts as the backend companion for [VelocityUtils](https://modrinth.com/plugin/velocityutils-rexi), enabling additional features from Spigot/Paper servers. --- ## 🧩 PlaceholderAPI Support This plugin provides the following *placeholders* if you have [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) installed: - `%velocityutils_globalplayers%` — Total number of players on the entire network. - `%velocityutils_players_%` — Number of players on a specific server. --- ## 💬 Special Chats The following internal chat channels are available: - **StaffChat** — For communication between staff members. - **AdminChat** — For communication between administrators. --- ## 🚨 Command: `/vualert ` Sends an alert message to the entire network. Useful for sending alerts from the backend console (for example, from custom menus) --- ## ✅ Requirements - [VelocityUtils](https://modrinth.com/plugin/velocityutils-rexi) Installed on your Velocity proxy. - [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) Optional, only if you want to use placeholders --- ## 💬 Need Help or Support? 📖 Wiki: https://rexi666-plugins.gitbook.io/rexi666/velocityutils Join my Discord server (Spanish/English):
